name: gespan-desktop
description: A desktop GUI for your coding agents
author: vasanth

scripts.check: bun run test:host && bun run check:rust && bun run lint && bun run test:app
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/dev.test.mjs scripts/bench.test.mjs scripts/bundle-macos.test.mjs scripts/cargo-workspaces.test.mjs scripts/dependencies.test.mjs scripts/desktop-release.test.mjs scripts/fetch-herdr.test.mjs scripts/fetch-sherpa-onnx.test.mjs scripts/package.test.mjs scripts/readme-release.test.mjs
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --locked -p gespan-tracker-client && cargo test --locked -p gespan-board-store && bun run test:app
scripts.test:app: cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-core --profile native-dev && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-gpui --profile native-dev -- --test-threads=1 && cargo build --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-gpui --profile native-dev && cargo test --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-first-launch --profile native-dev
scripts.lint: bun run test:scripts && cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/gespan-gpui/Cargo.toml -p gespan-core -p gespan-gpui -p gespan-first-launch --all-targets --profile native-dev -- -D warnings
scripts.check:app: bun run lint && bun run test:rust
